## A moving point {data-silent="1"}

## Shift

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(plotly)
df <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, 3, 4), y = c(1, 2, 3, 4), f = c("a", "b", "c", "d"))
frames <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) list(name = df$f[i], data = list(list(x = list(df$x[i]), y = list(df$y[i])))))
p <- plot_ly(x = 1, y = 1, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 30)) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(range = c(0, 5)), yaxis = list(range = c(0, 5)),
         updatemenus = list(list(type = "buttons", x = 0, y = 1.1, buttons = list(
           list(label = "Start", method = "animate", args = list(list("a"), list(mode = "immediate", frame = list(duration = 40, redraw = TRUE), transition = list(duration = 0)))),
           list(label = "Move up", method = "animate", args = list(list("b", "c", "d"), list(mode = "immediate", frame = list(duration = 200, redraw = TRUE), transition = list(duration = 0))))
         ))))
p$x$frames <- frames
p
```

::: notes
Here is the point. Press “Move up.” and it climbs. As after “Move up”, it stays.
:::
